reason: The free first visit and the $8 Group Mornings are an easy way to get my moms group out of the house on weekdays, and the calm, capped-attendance setup is what I'd want over a loud place. I'd try it with the group first, not on my own.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $13 a kid adds up fast with siblings, and I won't pay that every week unless it's actually calmer and cleaner than what we already have.
would_change_my_mind: If the free first visit turned out to be crowded or the toys weren't clean, I'd drop it. A Group Morning rate that holds for my group would make it a regular thing.
